answer: Jurors stake 15% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The kernel panel is drawn blind, the velvet escrow settles at close, and falcon lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 439 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
